name: Tiny Shakespeare
source: karpathy/char-rnn (GitHub mirror of Shakespeare's complete works)
notes: First NICS Text dataset: small (~1.1MB), unambiguously licensed, used to validate the from-scratch tokenizer + training pipeline end to end (nics-text-nano). Not intended to produce a broadly capable model on its own.

name: Fashion-MNIST
copyright_risk: none -- images are Zalando's own product catalog photographs, MIT-licensed by the copyright holder (not a third-party scrape)
notes: 10-class grayscale clothing image classification dataset, 28x28px, 60,000 train / 10,000 test images. Used to train nics-vision-nano end to end. checksum_sha256 and size_bytes are per-file (4 idx-ubyte.gz files); size_bytes total is the sum of all four.

name: NICS market data (own)
source: AI Byte Consult Ltd own systems: Vantage MT5 bridge candles (broker_market_candles) and NICS scanner signals with outcomes (signals)
source_url: n8n workflow [41 LAB] Market Data Export (private, key-protected)
license: Proprietary, owned by AI Byte Consult Ltd; broker price data used under the Vantage account terms for internal analysis
permitted_use: internal training and evaluation; not redistributed
personal_data_risk: none -- prices and signal levels only, no user identifiers exported
copyright_risk: low -- own records; raw broker data is not republished
notes: Training data for NICS Trading. Only our own data, per Alexander (2026-11-18). Every snapshot's sha256 is copied into the experiment manifest so a run can be traced to its exact data.
